items.title: perf(sqlite): avoid copying complete worker transfer records (#182932)
items.summary: perf(sqlite): avoid copying complete worker transfer records (#182932) Reuse complete SQLite worker frame bytes before deserialization instead of allocating and copying a second buffer. Preserve validation, error handling, and owned assembly for fragmented records. Paired receiver CPU per operation improved 39.8%, 13.8%, and 6.4% for the measured 1/16/128 KiB records; the 9 MiB fragmented control was neutral. Keep measurement tooling and a synthetic reply census for reproducible owner-level proof. Validated with focused framing/admission and caller tests, isolated synthetic Gateway turns, independent review, and exact-head PR CI. The sole failed test job matches seven onboarding fixture failures on scheduled main; landed under the authorized inherited-failure exception. No transaction, admission, schema, or decoded-value contract changes.

items.summary: fix: retry asks the model to continue dropped reasoning when a turn hits the output limit (#182429) A reasoning-only turn that ends at the output token limit is omitted from provider replay (#88656), but the reasoning-only recovery still asked the model to "continue from that partial turn" in a paid retry. Reuse the replay predicate for continuation eligibility so that turn ends with the existing output-limit outcome. Replayed reasoning-only stops keep their continuation; structured refusals stay terminal. Related: #182178 Co-authored-by: Dmitriy
